# Bounced

> Bounced builds and maintains artist websites and supports the technical systems around music, shows, merchandise, fan links, domains, email, and related accounts.

- Canonical site: https://bounced.studio/
- Project inquiries: https://bounced.studio/#contact
- Email: artists@bounced.studio

## Company

Bounced is operated by Dezolent, LLC. It provides artist website development and digital operations services. Bounced is not a booking agency, record label, or provider of traditional artist management.

## Current services

- Custom artist websites for releases, shows, merchandise, biography, and fan actions.
- Connections to supported music, show, store, email, and account services where appropriate for the artist.
- Optional domain, hosting, website update, search-foundation, and technical maintenance support.
- Searchable or filterable music catalogs built from reviewed release data.
- Release fan-link routes on an artist's own domain, with platform destinations reviewed for accuracy.
- Private catalog reviews that can compare Spotify recordings with The MLC's musical-work records where source access and coverage permit. Results require human review and do not prove ownership, missing royalties, or payment eligibility.

## Selected work

- Dezolent: https://dezolent.com/

## In development

ArtistOps is a dashboard concept for connected artist data. It is in development and is not a currently available product. Current Bounced services are the website and technical services listed above.
